answer.text: Place the motorcycle upright on a firm, level surface.
Front: with the reservoir horizontal, the fluid level should be at the center of the window, which the manual treats as the minimum level.
Rear: with the reservoir horizontal, the fluid level should be between the MAX and Min marks.
Clean the filler cap before removing it, and top up only with DOT 4 brake fluid from a sealed container.
Do not mix DOT 4 with other brake fluid, and refill with the same type.

policy.text: Keep water and dust out of the reservoir when refilling, because water lowers the boiling point of the fluid and dirt can clog the ABS hydraulic unit valves.

watchouts.text: Brake fluid is highly corrosive and can damage painted parts, so keep it off every part of the motorcycle and wipe up any spill at once with a soft cloth.
An insufficient brake fluid level will cause the brake system to fail.
Keep brake fluid away from children, and keep it off your skin, eyes and clothing.

watchout_review.reason: Corrosion and spill warning is the first watchout.
Mixing warning is already stated in the answer.
Low level causing brake failure is the second watchout.
Concerns fluid age and changing, not topping up.
Concerns the periodic change schedule, not topping up.
Keep-away-from-children warning is in the third watchout.
Skin, eye and clothing warning is in the third watchout.
Corrosion and spill warning is in the first watchout.
